facts.value: An instant strike that deals 100% weapon damage (145% if a Dagger is equipped) and causes the target to take 15% increased Rupture and Garrote damage from the Rogue. Lasts 15 sec. Awards 1 Combo Point.

facts.label: Boot Knife (Subtlety)
facts.value: Boot Knife has 5 ranks and sits on row 6, column 3 of the Subtlety tree.

facts.label: Boot Knife rank 1 of 5
facts.value: Grants your Shank ability a 20% chance to add 2 Combo Points to the target.

facts.label: Boot Knife rank 2 of 5
facts.value: Grants your Shank ability a 40% chance to add 2 Combo Points to the target.

facts.label: Boot Knife rank 3 of 5
facts.value: Grants your Shank ability a 60% chance to add 2 Combo Points to the target.

facts.label: Boot Knife rank 4 of 5
facts.value: Grants your Shank ability a 80% chance to add 2 Combo Points to the target.

facts.label: Boot Knife rank 5 of 5
facts.value: Grants your Shank ability a 100% chance to add 2 Combo Points to the target.

facts.label: Death Mark (Subtlety)
facts.value: Death Mark has 1 rank and sits on row 7, column 2 of the Subtlety tree. It requires Preparation. In use: 25 Energy, 1 to 5 Combo Points, 20 yd range, Instant, 10 sec cooldown.

facts.label: Death Mark rank 1 of 1
facts.value: Finishing move that marks the target, storing a portion of the damage dealt by your attacks per Combo Point. Garrote and Rupture damage is stored at twice the rate. After 6 sec, the stored damage is dealt, up to a maximum increased by Attack Power and Critical Strike chance: 1 point : 12% stored, 165 damage cap 2 points: 24% stored, 267 damage cap 3 points: 36% stored, 369 damage cap 4 points: 48% stored, 471 damage cap 5 points: 60% stored, 573 damage cap
